data.name: Eden: Discovery
data.detailed_description:
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic free-for-all extraction shooter where 10 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out - or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.

Every raid matters. The gear you find, the fights you pick, the moment you decide to run for extraction instead of pushing for one more crate. All of it counts. The combat is PvPvE. You're not just watching your back for other players. AI threats patrol key areas and guard high-value loot. Sometimes the smart play is avoiding a fight entirely. Sometimes you have no choice.

Tournaments and Showdowns

Want to raise the stakes? Enter buy-in matches where the winners walk away with serious rewards. Or settle beef with another player in a 1v1 showdown. Put up your loot or currency, and fight it out head to head. One walks away with everything.

Train Your Own Fighter (coming soon)

You can build and train your own AI agent that fights on your behalf. Set up its loadout, teach it how you like to play, and let it compete in AI vs AI battles. Your agent earns in-game currency while you're offline, sleeping, working, whatever. Log back in and collect what it won for you.

It's not replacing the core game. You still drop into the Wasteland yourself when you want that real extraction experience. But your agent keeps grinding in the background, stacking rewards for your next raid.

Player Economy

Everything you find or win has value. Trade gear with other players using in-game currency. Buy what you need, sell what you don't. The economy is driven entirely by players, so prices shift based on what's rare and what people actually want.

The Hub

Between raids, you hang out in a shared social space. Show off your best gear. Link up with friends before a match. Plan your next move. It's persistent, so your stuff stays on display. Think of it as your home base in a world that's constantly trying to kill you.

Creative Mode (Coming Soon)

Down the road, you'll be able to build your own maps and game modes. Host custom matches with whatever rules you want. The community gets to shape what the Wasteland becomes.

The Story

It's 2030 and the world already ended. Rogue AI kicked off a global war that spiraled out of control. A group of survivors escaped on a ship called Eden, hoping to wait it out in space. But Earth's collapse came faster than expected. They had to come back early.

They landed near the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. The area some believe was the original Garden of Eden. Now it's ground zero for rebuilding civilization. Every raid you run is part of that. Gathering resources, fighting for territory, slowly reclaiming a planet that tried to shake humanity off for good. The lore runs deep, and the world keeps expanding.

data.short_description: Eden: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic free-for-all extraction arena FPS. Scavenge loot, battle AI and rivals, and escape with your gear - or lose it all. Use in-game currency, run tournaments, and trade in a creator-driven world where every choice carries real stakes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 CPU or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 CPU or Equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Apple M2 Max
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: In EDEN: Discovery, players engage in intense first-person combat with both human opponents and AI enemies. There is violence, including the act of killing other characters, but no explicit gore or graphic depictions of injuries. While there are no sexual acts or references to sexual assault in the game, certain drug-like items can be used to boost health or stamina, reflecting the harsh, post-apocalyptic setting.
